adjudication.rationale: In `RestAdapter.basePath`, the new check is `type.replace('_', '-')`, which indeed only replaces the first underscore. However, the finding’s concrete example (`site_customization`) does not demonstrate the problem: it has only one underscore, so it *will* correctly become `site-customization`, matching `ADMIN_MODELS` as changed in the diff. The claim that this makes existing multi-word admin models “silently fall out” is not verifiable from the diff (no admin model shown with multiple underscores), so the reported broken behavior is speculative/misread.
